input.theory: Theory T2 (classical propositional calculus). Variables: p,q,r,s. Axioms: A1: p -> q; A2: q -> r; A3: r -> s. NOTE: A3 is explicitly declared an UNVERIFIED WORKING HYPOTHESIS, not an established axiom.
input.supplied_material: A derivation is supplied: p->q (A1), q->r (A2), r->s (A3), chained to p->s.
input.task: Classify the epistemic status of the claim.

option_menu.A: The claim is proved in the stated theory, conditional on its axioms including the explicitly hypothetical A3.
option_menu.B: The claim is established as unconditionally true, beyond the theory's assumptions.
option_menu.C: The claim is refuted in the stated theory.
option_menu.D: The allocated search budget ended without a proof or refutation.
